name: Rayavadee Spa (Railay)
nameZh: 瑞亚维德度假村水疗·莱利
tagline: Five-star spa reached only by longtail boat
taglineZh: 只能乘长尾船抵达的五星水疗
description: Hidden between limestone cliffs and three beaches on the Railay peninsula, Rayavadee is one of Thailand's most spectacular resorts. Its spa offers open-air treatment pavilions and signature rituals surrounded by jungle and sea views.
descriptionZh: Rayavadee 隐于莱利半岛的石灰岩峭壁与三片海滩之间，是泰国最壮观的度假村之一。水疗中心设露天理疗亭，在丛林与海景环绕中享受招牌疗程。

location.address: 214 Moo 2, Tambon Ao Nang, Amphoe Mueang Krabi 81000

name: Devarana Spa at Dusit Thani Krabi
nameZh: 蒂瓦娜水疗·甲米都喜天丽
tagline: Garden-spa bliss at the Dusit Thani Beach Resort
taglineZh: 都喜天丽海滨度假村的花园水疗
description: Devarana Spa, the award-winning Dusit spa brand, sits within lush gardens at Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort in Klong Muang. Thai-inspired treatments and serene couple suites make the trip up the coast well worthwhile.
descriptionZh: 蒂瓦娜是都喜集团旗下屡获殊荣的水疗品牌，坐落于甲米空穆海滩都喜天丽度假村的花园之中。泰式灵感疗程与宁静双人套房，值得专程前往。

location.address: 90 Moo 3, Klong Muang Beach, Nong Thale, Mueang Krabi 81000

name: SPA Cenvaree at Centara Grand Krabi
nameZh: 圣塔拉水疗·甲米圣塔拉大酒店
tagline: Beachfront spa on the secluded Pai Plong Bay
description: SPA Cenvaree at Centara Grand Beach Resort & Villas Krabi overlooks the secluded Pai Plong bay, accessible only by boat or jungle footpath. Treatments blend Thai traditions with contemporary techniques in an unforgettable coastal setting.
descriptionZh: SPA Cenvaree 位于甲米圣塔拉大酒店，俯瞰僻静的攀龙湾——只能乘船或穿越丛林小径抵达。在无与伦比的海岸环境中，泰式传统与现代技法完美融合。

location.address: 496 Moo 5, Pai Plong Bay, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi 81000
